expressions.pattern: ^(?:its easy )?first(?: of all)? (?:you need to|you have to|you should) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,10})$
expressions.accept_note: 명령형(First, boil the water.)은 뜻 전달(부분). 이 과의 목표는 ‘you need to’.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:and )?(?:make sure (?:you|to)|dont forget to|be careful not to) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,10})$

ok: Make sure you don’t burn it.
And make sure you don’t add too much oil.

scene.en: Moa, your kimchi fried rice is amazing. How do you make it?
It’s easy! First, you need to cut the kimchi.
Then you fry it with rice. Make sure you use old kimchi.
It tastes better. And make sure you don’t add too much oil.
